mentions.name: Privacy-first AI self-improvement app
mentions.description: This GDPR-compliant, privacy-first app uses AI, developed in partnership with a psychologist and an HR director, to analyze users' personality, motivation, procrastination, and other behavioral patterns beyond what standard 1–5 form tests capture, then recommends activities to improve weak points. It emphasizes anonymity with an audited log table for record access, accessibility, and an affordable price point as an alternative to human coaching, and is nearing a free beta launch.
mentions.problem: Human coaches are limited by their own worldview and bias, people fear being judged, and many individuals lack the time, resources, or money to hire coaches and grow personally.
mentions.audience: A consumer self-improvement product aimed at people who can't afford human coaches, such as those with limited time and resources.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a GDPR compliant, privacy first, AI self improvement app.
mentions.author: msejas
